problem: The game is a 3-8 turn race, far under the 14-24 / 18-30 / 20-34 band (about 1.8 / 2.9 / 3.2 minutes at 0.4 per turn against the 12-minute target). Long Night fell from 95-100% to 0-0.1%, but the cure overshoots.
evidence: headline 1,000 games per count: 4.4 / 7.2 / 8.0 mean turns; 2p minimum is the theoretical 3. Switch-off test: SHIELD off gives 22.6 / 33.7 / 30.4 turns; every other switch moves length by under 1 turn except WIN_AT_END (16.8 / 29.5 / 27.9 with 5-56% Long Night (50-56% at 3-4p)) and Rebound (2.3 / 4.4 / 5.5, worse).
fix: The shield is the length lever: it lets a body build up untouched, so a 4-body pattern lands on a player's 2nd-3rd turn. Either drop the shield (then 2p fits at 22.6 turns, 3p/4p return to 83-87% Long Night, need a smaller Deck: untested) or keep it and start with 0 bodies (orbit empty; 8.3 / 14.8 / 18.3 turns, 2p still short). Best untested pair: opening 0 plus shield, plus +1 to every Critical Mass threshold.

problem: Seat 1 has a large tempo edge at every count.
evidence: seat gap 16.9 / 29.1 / 18.4 points (seat 1 wins 66.9% at 2p, 62.4% at 3p, 43.4% at 4p) vs the 5-point target. Falls to 11.3 at 2p with 1 opening body, 4.9 at 3p and 10.0 at 4p with 0 opening bodies; shield off at 2p is 5.5.
fix: Short races always favour the first mover. Lengthening the game (problem 1) is the main fix. Cheap extra: the last seat draws 2 cards on its first turn, or the first player also skips Launch on turn 1.

problem: The strategic bot loses to the greedy bot; skill expression against a real rival is negative (the studio check for a dominant simple strategy).
evidence: strategic vs greedy: -14.0 / -8.0 / -13.1 points at 2/3/4p (vs random: +98.0 / +95.8 / +92.3; greedy vs random +95.8 / +93.0 / +91.9). Greedy mirror: Critical Mass wins 81 / 89 / 93% of pattern endings vs 27 / 34 / 40% in the strategic mirror. 'Take the biggest bodies' is the dominant plan; the other two patterns only pay off for a bot that plans them. Last cycle strategic beat greedy by +38 / +16 / -6.
fix: Either Critical Mass thresholds up (17 / 16 / 15 tested only for 2p, where share falls 27% to 17% but length stays 4.6) or give Constellation and Alignment a lower bar than Mass in tempo, not just share. Treat as a race-length problem first: in longer games captures can punish a pile of big bodies.

problem: Several twists are inert or nearly so: Recall, Comet beats Giant, the shield (as a skill), threat-aware spinning at 3-4p, and spinning others at 2p.
evidence: ablation margins at 2/3/4p (need 5 or more): no-recall -1.8 / -1.9 / 0.0; comet-blind 3.4 / 0.1 / 0.9; shield-blind 7.2 / 1.1 / 3.3; threat-blind 8.0 / 4.4 / 1.2; self-spin-only 2.2 / 32.1 / 11.4; defence-check (a worse bot) 30.2 / 16.6 / 7.9. Giants are captured 0.1 times per game; Comets sit in winning orbits 61% less often than their deck share.
fix: Rules cannot matter if games end before captures start (1.8 / 2.3 / 2.5 captures per game against the 15-25 band). Re-test the ablations after the length fix; if Recall and Comet-beats-Giant are still inert, cut Recall (it is also a line of rules).

problem: Runaway leader and lead changes miss the KPIs at 2p; a 'threat' is almost impossible to break.
evidence: orbit-total leader at the midpoint wins 74.7% at 2p (target 65%), 63.5% at 3p, 41% at 4p; lead changes 0.64 / 1.76 / 2.06 (target 2). Of positions one launch from a pattern, 83 / 79 / 77% are attacked, yet 100 / 61 / 48% are still one launch away at the owner's turn: at 2p a captured body is simply replaced by a hand card.
fix: Lengthening the game (opening 0 gives 2.4 / 5.2 / 6.5 lead changes and runaway 0.80 / 0.50 / 0.33). A cheaper defence at 2p: captured bodies go to the attacker's hand AND the owner may not Launch into the slot just captured.

problem: Constellation (rainbow) is the most common ending at 2p; Alignment drops to 21-23% at 3-4p.
evidence: strategic mirror shares mass / const / align: 27 / 46 / 28 (2p), 34 / 45 / 21 (3p), 40 / 37 / 23 (4p), all inside 15-50%. Rainbow off: const 7% (dead), so the rainbow is needed. CM_BY_COUNT is inert (CM 15 everywhere: shares 37 / 34 / 29, length unchanged).
fix: Keep the rainbow. The per-count thresholds are not worth a rule while games are this short.

problem: Alternative arms do not help length.
evidence: DECK40: 4.7 / 7.3 / 8.0 turns, Long Night 0 / 0.8 / 1.5%. CAPTURE_TO_DS: 4.7 / 7.3 / 8.1 turns, seat gap and runaway unchanged. DEEPSPACE_DRAW on: 4.4 / 6.9 / 7.9 turns (inert).
fix: Drop both as length fixes; DECK40 only if the box size matters.
